name: Summoned!: Into a Dungeon Without My Meat Bun
source:
You suddenly wake up in a dark dungeon. An Elf girl stands before you, looking desperate, and says you're her last hope.

What's going on?

Just a moment ago, you were sitting in your favorite spot at the meat bun shop and were about to enjoy your warm, fluffy meat bun after a bad day at school. Now, you're in this strange place, and the Elf girl brought you here without your meat bun?!

How can you help her on an empty stomach?!

[From [url=https://yui-enajori.itch.io/summoned-into-a-dungeon-without-my-meat-bun]Itch.io[/url]]
